footnote_text: The 1,450 Remarketable Variable Rate MuniFund Term Preferred Shares, Series 2054, ("RVMTP Shares") reported as disposed of in Table I represent shares that were beneficially owned by Banc of America Preferred Funding Corporation ("BAPFC"). The 1,450 RVMTP Shares held by BAPFC were redeemed by the Issuer on October 30, 2026, as described in the Notice of Intention to Redeem Securities, N-23C-2, filed by the Issuer with the SEC on September 15, 2026, for a redemption price of the liquidation preference and accumulated but unpaid dividends. BAPFC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation. || This statement is jointly filed by Bank of America Corporation and BAPFC. Bank of America Corporation held an indirect interest in the securities listed in Table I by virtue of its indirect ownership of BAPFC. || Each reporting person declares that neither the filing of this statement nor anything herein shall be construed as an admission that such person is, for the purposes of Section 13(d) of the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or any other purpose, (i) acting (or has agreed or is agreeing to act together with any other person) as a partnership, limited partnership, syndicate or other group for the purpose of acquiring, holding or disposing of securities of the Issuer or otherwise with respect to the Issuer or any securities of the Issuer or (ii) a member of any group with respect to the Issuer or any securities of the Issuer.
